releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.3 - Official Repository Migration & In-App Auto-Update Sync
highlights: Migrated primary GitHub repository from grok-build to fiko942/aethergrok across backend updater, settings UI, and release manager.
Updated in-app updates tab, about section cards, and documentation links to support seamless auto-updates from new repo.
Integrated automated strict pre-flight release validation (TypeScript, Vitest, Svelte Vite, Go tests, app build).

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.2 - Voice Dictation Equalizer, macOS Permissions Wizard & Grok Auto-Installer
highlights: Dual-mode voice dictation shortcuts (Push-to-Talk & Double-Tap Lock) with automated system audio mute ducking and a real-time 4-bar dynamic equalizer
Anti-Gravity inspired macOS system permissions onboarding wizard with real-time 3-second polling and window focus auto-refresh.
Automatic Grok CLI runtime detection with 1-click in-app installer and persistent diagnostic logging to ~/.grok/logs/aethergrok.log.
Dark mode styling refinements removing harsh white borders, alongside single-line layout alignment for updates and changelog history cards.

releases.title: AetherGrok 1.0.1 - Backend Persistent Storage & Multi-Platform CI/CD
highlights: Migrasi pengaturan (settings), daftar workspace, dan status tab/UI dari sekadar frontend localStorage ke format penyimpanan backend file murni Go (~/.grok/*.jsonl), sehingga konfigurasi dan mode persetujuan dapat langsung dibaca oleh Go backend.
Penambahan toolchain rilis otomatis dan terpusat (pnpm run release dan changelog.json).
Penyiapan pipeline GitHub Actions yang membuild installer desktop untuk macOS (.dmg) dan Windows (.exe NSIS) secara otomatis.
Penambahan flag macOS minimum deployment untuk merapikan warning compiler AVFoundation dan pemisahan build tags platform.
